coverage.scope: All 19 manual Social Links, ranks 1–10: recommended affinity responses and essential route decisions. Neutral prompts are omitted; row numbers count listed decisions, not all in-game prompts. Optional holiday invitations are outside this table.
limitations: Some supplemental friendship choices have no verified reward or English option index; these fields are intentionally absent.
This is a reference for individual rank events, not a guaranteed calendar route or an exhaustive list of losing responses.

pointRules.summary: Carry a Persona of the same Arcana when building affinity. These are short response cues, not exact dialogue quotations. A missing reward means it was not established, not zero.
pointRules.basePoints: Hidden affinity before bonuses, from the numeric reference. These are not the visible musical notes.
pointRules.displayNotesWithMatching: The per-character guide reports these 1–3 rewards with a matching Persona. Do not multiply them or treat them as raw affinity.
pointRules.matchingArcana: Any Persona of the matching Arcana in stock provides the bonus; it does not need to be equipped.
pointRules.multiplierNote: Top-of-class replaces top-ten; the other listed multipliers stack. Visible notes are capped and do not expose the exact accumulated affinity.

sources.locator: Social Links: bonus multipliers and unboosted answer points

relationshipRules.note: Reload does not reverse links through neglect and has no permanent Broken state. Yukari and Chihiro have avoidable rank-5 reversals; Nozomi has a scripted one.
